# reco_threat_detection_exclusion (Resource)

Manages a Reco threat detection exclusion that suppresses matching alerts. State changes (on, on until valid_until, or off) use the exclusion state API. Destroy deletes the exclusion.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "reco_threat_detection_policy" "admin_role_granted" {
  title                = "Administrator role granted"
  description          = "Alerts when a user is granted an administrator role."
  data_source          = "GSUITE_ADMIN_AUDIT_LOG_API"
  violation_risk_level = "MEDIUM"
  violation_risk_type  = "RISK_TYPE_USER"
  default_status       = "POLICY_STATUS_PREVIEW"
  conditions_jsonata   = "$.eventName = 'ASSIGN_ROLE' and $contains($.roleName, 'Admin')"
  description_template = "'Administrator role granted to ' & $.targetUser"
}

resource "reco_threat_detection_exclusion" "service_account" {
  name        = "Trusted service account"
  description = "Suppress alerts for the break-glass automation account."
  expression  = "$.actor.email = 'svc-breakglass@example.com'"
  policy_ids  = [reco_threat_detection_policy.admin_role_granted.id]
}

resource "reco_threat_detection_exclusion" "maintenance_window" {
  name        = "Maintenance window"
  expression  = "$.eventName = 'ASSIGN_ROLE'"
  is_global   = true
  state       = "VIOLATION_EXCLUSION_STATE_ON_TEMPORARY"
  valid_until = "2026-12-31T00:00:00Z"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `expression` (String) JSONata expression evaluated against each policy violation. A violation is suppressed when it evaluates to true.
- `name` (String) Display name of the exclusion.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Longer description shown in the Reco UI. Omit to leave it empty.
- `instance_ids` (List of String) Restrict the exclusion to violations from these integration instances. Omit to include every instance.
- `is_global` (Boolean) Apply the exclusion to every threat detection policy. policy_ids and instance_ids must then be omitted.
- `policy_ids` (List of String) Threat detection policy IDs this exclusion applies to. Required unless is_global is true.
- `state` (String) VIOLATION_EXCLUSION_STATE_ON_PERMANENT (default), VIOLATION_EXCLUSION_STATE_ON_TEMPORARY, or VIOLATION_EXCLUSION_STATE_OFF. Changing it calls the exclusion state API.
- `valid_until` (String) RFC3339 timestamp when an ON_TEMPORARY exclusion turns off, for example 2026-12-31T00:00:00Z. Required when state is VIOLATION_EXCLUSION_STATE_ON_TEMPORARY. Omit it otherwise.

### Read-Only

- `apps` (List of String) Applications the exclusion applies to (read-only).
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (read-only).
- `created_by` (String) User who created the exclusion (read-only).
- `id` (String) Exclusion ID (stable UUID, set after create).
- `policy_id` (String) Policy ID when the exclusion targets exactly one policy (read-only).
- `policy_name` (String) Name of policy_id (read-only).
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp (read-only).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = reco_threat_detection_exclusion.service_account
  id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
}
```
